text:
```yaml
name: Infisical Testing

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: useblacksmith/setup-node@v5
      with:
        node-version: '16'
        always-auth: true

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci

    - name: Run tests
      run: npm test

    - name: Lint code
      run: npm run lint

    - name: Build project
      run: npm run build

    - name: Run integration tests
      run: npm run integration-test
```
